lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots arranged in approximately four to five longitudinal rows along the mid-lateral flank, with higher density and smaller diameter observed in the anterior region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes most prominent in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal carinae running parallel along the upper two-thirds of the visible flank; the primary medial ridge displays a sharp vertical gradient with high-intensity luminance on the dorsal-facing surface and deep shadow on the ventral-facing surface.
